title: API Observability
description: Real HTTP, authentication, PostgreSQL pool/transactions, email, Node runtime and correlated logs/traces. See operating notes for measurement boundaries.

panels.title: Read before interpreting
panels.description: Selected environment and instance. No data may mean no observations; inspect scrape health before interpreting.

options.content:
**No data is not healthy.** Check API scrape health and metric age first. Ratios/percentiles are undefined without traffic; rates need multiple 15-second scrapes. All durations are seconds.

**Boundaries:** 2xx/3xx describes HTTP responses. Recovery 202 does not prove dispatch; provider acceptance does not prove inbox delivery. Database transaction duration is not SQL query latency. Pool/runtime/dependency panels ignore route/method filters. GET / is a business endpoint and any manual smoke requests count as traffic.

**Alerts:** API/DB unavailable for 2m; 5xx >5% or p95 >1s with ≥20 requests/5m for 5m; pool waiting >0 for 5m; provider failure in 5m for 1m; event-loop p99 >200ms for 5m. These are starting operational thresholds, not a contractual SLO. Grafana no-data/evaluation errors need investigation. External notification delivery is unconfigured.

**Investigate:** expand a log and select View trace. Backend troubleshooting: Alloy http://localhost:12345, then datasource health in Grafana and backend /ready. Logs and traces have backend retention; no bodies, tokens, email contents or SQL parameters are exported.
